header.running_head: The Marriages of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA)

blocks.text: (RA) got up and opened the door, Rasulullaah ﷺ asked, 'O Ummu Ayman! Call my brother for me.' She said, 'He is your brother and you got him married to your daughter?' 'O Ummu Ayman!' Rasulullaah ﷺ continued, 'Do call him for me.' When the other women heard Rasulullaah ﷺ's voice, they dispersed and he took a seat in the corner. Ali (RA) then arrived and after making du'aa for him, Rasulullaah ﷺ sprinkled some water on him as well. Thereafter, Rasulullaah ﷺ sent for Faatima (RA). She arrived all covered in perspiration and taking short steps out of her extreme modesty. 'Relax,' Rasulullaah ﷺ reassured her, 'I have married you to the family member I love the most.'" The rest of the narration is like the one quoted above. [^1]

Hadhrat Ali (RA) narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ got him married to Hadhrat Faatima (RA), Rasulullaah ﷺ sent for some water and then gargled with it. Rasulullaah ﷺ then took Hadhrat Ali (RA) into the room where he sprinkled the water on his chest and between his shoulders and then sought Allaah's protection for him by reciting Surah Ikhlaas (Surah 112) and the Mu'awwadhatayn (Surah Falaq and Surah Naas). [^2]

Hadhrat Albaa bin Ahmar reports from Hadhrat Ali (RA) that when he proposed for Rasulullaah ﷺ's daughter Hadhrat Faatima (RA), he sold a suit of armour he owned as well as some of his other possessions for a sum of four hundred and eighty Dirhams. Rasulullaah ﷺ instructed him to use two-thirds for perfume and the remaining third for clothing. Rasulullaah ﷺ then gargled in a utensil of water and told the couple to bath with it. Rasulullaah ﷺ also instructed Hadhrat Faatima (RA) not to feed any of her children before he got to the child, but she started feeding Hadhrat Husayn (RA) before Rasulullaah ﷺ could arrive. As for Hadhrat Hasan (RA), Rasulullaah ﷺ put some unknown thing in his mouth because of which he was more knowledgeable than his brother. [^3]

Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) narrates, "We attended the marriage of Ali (RA) and Faatima (RA) and have not witnessed a better marriage. The matting (on which we sat) was stuffed with the bark of a date palm and we were served raisins and dates to eat. Her bedding on her first night was a sheepskin." [^4]
Hadhrat Ali (RA) reports that when Hadhrat Faatima (RA) got married, Rasulullaah ﷺ gave her a blanket, a water bag and a leather pillow stuffed with Idhkhir grass. [^5]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Amr (RA) reports that when Rasulullaah ﷺ sent Hadhrat Faatima (RA) to (her husband) Hadhrat Ali (RA), Rasulullaah ﷺ gave her a blanket, a water bag and a leather pillow stuffed with the bark of a date palm and Idhkhir grass. The couple slept on (half of) the blanket and used
